chat.text: Do you ever use your laptop?
I like that. It sounds like something the library would try to teach me and I'd pretend I already knew. What else? I've got 2 foraged things in my pouch — I keep checking they're still there.

Dilly, Mabel and Pip are my pond committee. I ask them things and they just… float there, very wisely. I trust their judgment more than most people. I've got 2 foraged things in my pouch — I keep checking they're still there.
OK, what is your favourite color?
Right? I thought so too. What do you think the ducks would say about your day? I asked them about mine and Mabel took a full minute to decide.

That one sat with me for a second. The pond's good for sitting with things, but you're better. What were you doing when it crossed your mind? What's a song I should hum while I walk? I need new material.
